summary: Male in his mid-20s missing in Great Sand Dunes NP after separating from a hiking companion the day before; little food or water and not dressed for cold summer nights; AVSAR + NPS searched with air support planned for the next day; found safe at the Sand Dunes Oasis by an NPS ranger ~5:03 p.m.
notes: Date = mission date; incident began ~0200 July 7, 2014.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Alamosa County, Colorado, United States)
